facts.fact: Alys 带 Estiene 到破庙脚下的小市场，向老摊主 Leon 买 Lefer 爱吃的栗子酱；她握着 Leon 的手治了将近十分钟关节炎，指节明显变小
facts.anchor: Alys closed her eyes and stood there healing him for nearly ten minutes

facts.fact: Estiene 向 Lefer 坦白：上周父亲为 Duchy Council 成员设宴并叫他作陪，他在楼下无意听到父亲与 Chancellor Colet Morant 商定，保证他大考不失败、毕业排名靠前
facts.anchor: agreeing that Estiene would not fail the Grand Exam

facts.fact: Lefer 说她不知道那次具体安排、也没有记录可答；又说今年除「公然且明显的灾难」外，大概不会让任何人失败
facts.anchor: I doubt anyone will be allowed to fail this year

facts.fact: Lefer 透露：midsummer 治理委员会将把 Saige 或 Brodier 之一「重组」出职位；两人自 midyear 起就知道只有一个能留下
facts.anchor: One of them will be restructured out of a position

facts.fact: Lefer 说 36 个考试组及其时段都是随机抽签，由 Dean Brodier 与一名宣誓保密的 under-secretary 抽，名单钉在板上，通常在考前几天才做
facts.anchor: the thirty-six exam groups were randomly chosen, yes, as were their time slots

facts.fact: Estiene 追问：父亲的那项请求，是否就是 Brodier 出任本组考官的原因
facts.anchor: why Dean Brodier is one of our group’s examiners

facts.fact: Alys 自述：Saige 叫她单独会面，提出用「私人辅导」帮她弥补缺陷；她拒绝后，第二天就传出她主动勾引 Saige、反被拒绝的谣言
facts.anchor: The rumours that I’d propositioned him, and that he’d refused me, started the next day.

facts.fact: Alys 对 Estiene 说：他父亲确实相信他，但不如相信自己那么多；Estiene 认为这话说得通
facts.anchor: But not as much as he believes in himself.
